verdict.rationale: Lorikeet's workflows and escalation logic imply event-driven automation (e.g., automatic human handoff when AI can't resolve, escalation paths for sensitive situations, natural-language workflow building), but there's no explicit documentation of a user-defined rules/trigger engine for arbitrary events. missing for 10: explicit rule-definition UI/API, list of triggerable event types, and confirmation that non-support events (not just tickets) can trigger workflows.
